Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results, relying on an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet that incorrectly listed Countess Palatine Christiane Henriette of Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld as George II’s mother. This ignored the authoritative Wikipedia snippet on the same results page stating his mother was Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen. As a result, the Planner confused the paternal grandmother with the paternal great-grandmother and finalized the wrong answer without proper cross-verification.
